open_points.question: If the run directory itself or an entry inside it is a symbolic link, should the link inode be unlinked, or should the call fail without removing it?
open_points.default_guess: Raise StoreInternalError on any symbolic link.

open_points.subject: remove_run_spool run_id

rely on model validation not described here

open_points.question: What directory and filename layout encodes producer_node_id, map_index, attempt_number, producer_port and list_index without collisions?
options: one escaped filename containing every field
open_points.default_guess: Use a nested, safely encoded hierarchy ending in a filename that includes producer_port and list_index.

open_points.subject: spool_file ceiling count
open_points.text: counted as the bytes of the files already in it, less a file no SpooledFile record names at this file's position, plus content
open_points.question: Are temporary files, directories, links, malformed entries and orphaned files at other positions included, and is the existing target subtracted only when it is unnamed?

count all filesystem entries by apparent size
count only files with valid SpooledFileKey paths

open_points.subject: spool_file ceiling order

open_points.question: Must the per-file ceiling be checked before inspecting or cleaning the run spool, and which refusal reason wins when both ceilings are exceeded?
open_points.default_guess: Check and report the per-file ceiling first.

open_points.subject: spool_file refusal cleanup

open_points.question: Does “this file” include a previously published file at the same full key, and must a file already named by a SpooledFile record be preserved even if it shares the attempt?
options: remove only unnamed files of the attempt
remove all files including recorded ones
a recorded same-attempt file makes refusal cleanup an internal error
open_points.default_guess: Remove only unnamed files and raise StoreInternalError if cleanup would require deleting a recorded file.

open_points.subject: spool_file existing target
open_points.text: a file already at that position that no SpooledFile record names ... is replaced, while one a SpooledFile record names is never overwritten
open_points.question: How is replacement made atomically without a window of no target, and what happens if the target becomes recorded between the repository check and rename?
options: recheck immediately before and after replacement
open_points.default_guess: Serialize calls with a module lock, recheck the row immediately before atomic replacement, and treat a detected race as StoreInternalError.

open_points.subject: spool_file publication durability
open_points.text: write a temporary file, flush and fsync it, check its digest and size, and rename it into place
open_points.question: Must the spool directory also be fsynced before spool_file returns?
open_points.default_guess: Always fsync the containing directory.

open_points.subject: concurrency

options: protect every operation with one module lock
use per-operation connections despite the one-connection rule
open_points.default_guess: Protect all store and filesystem operations with one reentrant module lock.
